metadata.description: Personal Claude Code plugins: a thinking council and a token-cheap memory vault.

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: Sharper critical thinking + a 4-agent discussion council (Believer, Skeptic, Investor, Judge) for big decisions.

plugins.name: memory-vault
plugins.description: Long-term memory that is cheap to use: a tiny index loaded at session start, details pulled only when needed.

plugins.name: token-saver
plugins.description: Cuts token use: lean-work rules, a guard against reading huge files whole, and /handoff to restart in a fresh, cheap context.

plugins.name: genius-dev
plugins.description: Genius coding mode: a 10-role dev council that only spends credits when the task is worth it.
